source_locator: Sections2.1–2.3 and data availability; author XAA_px30.m axis/integration code.
source_access: Primary publisher indexed full HTML and version-pinned author MATLAB code reviewed. No original paper figure pixels or digitization claimed.
reconstruction_limitations: Velocity sections combine HR-XBT, Argo and satellite SLA. Monthly estimates are reconstructed, not independently observed monthly full-depth sections. Below800m PX30 hydrographic structure is statistically extended from Argo relationships.
Argo reference velocity near1000m is a time-invariant mean. Source vel_err is a velocity standard-error term and has not been propagated to depth. Physical depth confidence limits remain unknown.

Moving horizontal axis follows source midpoint-integrated five-point-triangle-smoothed maximum poleward transport per unit width. Vertical maximum speed and depth-integrated horizontal core are different quantities.

Mean calendar-month profiles use all16 year-specific moving-axis profiles at every retained depth. Threshold crossings of this mean differ from the mean of diagnosed individual crossings. No three-month filter or seasonal hypothesis test was applied.
Native2.5m upper sample maxima are flagged as shallow-domain edge maxima. They do not resolve a shallower unsampled core or establish a physical upper boundary.
5cm/s and10cm/s thresholds are explicit diagnostic definitions. The1975m product boundary is not current bottom; ten zero crossings remain right-censored. No thickness or volume is inferred.
